note: Our own list of the Pantone Color of the Year selections, 2002 to 2026. Codes are Pantone's Fashion, Home + Interiors (TCX) numbers; hex values are commonly published sRGB approximations, not official Pantone conversions. Notes are our own short descriptions.

colors.name: True Red
colors.note: A deep, confident red picked in the months after September 2001.

colors.name: Tigerlily
colors.note: A warm orange-red with a tropical feel.

colors.name: Blue Turquoise
colors.note: A soft turquoise between blue and green.

colors.name: Blue Iris
colors.note: A blue with a touch of purple.

colors.name: Mimosa
colors.note: A warm, hopeful yellow chosen during a hard economic year.

colors.name: Rose Quartz
colors.note: A gentle pink, paired with Serenity: the first year with two colors.

colors.name: Serenity
colors.note: A cool, airy blue, paired with Rose Quartz.

colors.name: Living Coral
colors.note: A warm coral with a golden undertone.

colors.name: Ultimate Gray
colors.note: A solid mid gray, paired with Illuminating.

colors.name: Illuminating
colors.note: A bright, cheerful yellow, paired with Ultimate Gray.

colors.name: Very Peri
colors.note: A periwinkle blue with violet-red undertones, the first color Pantone created for the title.

colors.name: Cloud Dancer
colors.note: A soft, airy white, the first white chosen.
